summary: Full-text avvisi search --all follows ANAC continuation tokens through the existing data-source resolver instead of pretending to paginate offsets.
reason: ANAC requires direzionePaginazione=AVANTI and tokenPaginazione; the generic offset path returned a successful first page for --all. Continuation failures or non-advancing tokens must fail rather than report partial results as complete.
validated_outcome: Mock endpoint tests prove multiple pages including short and duplicate-only middle pages, query/header preservation, malformed and repeated-token failures, a valid empty page, and unchanged single-page output.
